company.name: LightTwist
company.shortDescription: LightTwist is a visual effects company for developers and creatives that runs on the iPhone.
company.description:
LightTwist is a visual effects lab for developers and creatives on the iPhone.

It enables the user to create high-resolution video and picture assets that combine reality with immersive 3D environments.

LightTwist was founded in December 31, 2020 by Vikas Reddy and is based in Boulder, Colorado, United States.

aiResearchSummary.text: LightTwist is researching and developing a system for cloud based shared virtual studio environments that generates visual content where physically separated participants appear together in a unified scene. The system for facilitating and generating virtual studio environments and visual content supports live streaming as the live studio environment is rendered, enabling iPhone based creators to produce shared, composite visual effects and collaborative virtual studios as its core R and D areas.
